definitions.gloss: to replant; to transplant; to repot
definitions.explanation: To move a plant from one location or container to another. Common in gardening contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植|う}え{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replanted the flower in a bigger pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧になったら⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植|う}え{替|か}える⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to transplant the seedlings to the garden in spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まって→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{植|う}え{替|か}えた⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The roots are getting crowded, so you should repot it soon.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧ (to plant) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to replace/change). Primarily a gardening term.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植|う}え{替|か}える: to repot
- ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{植|う}え{替|か}える: to transplant into the garden
- ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{植|う}え{替|か}える: to transplant seedlings
- ⟦{植|う}え{替|か}え→植え替え：08231_uekae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: repotting season

USAGE:
The noun form is ⟦{植|う}え{替|か}え→植え替え：08231_uekae⟧. Spring is the most common season for repotting in Japan. Plants need repotting when ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧ (roots become crowded) or ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (soil becomes old).
